name: Homebrew
description: The package manager for macOS and Linux.
summary: Homebrew allows AI/LLM-assisted issues and pull requests, including AI-generated code and prose, provided contributors disclose the tool, review all generated content before requesting review, keep at least one human author on every commit, and answer maintainer questions and review comments themselves without AI. Non-maintainers may have only one AI-assisted pull request open at a time.

evidence.quote: We allow you to create issues and pull requests with AI/LLM with the following requirements (see [Responsible AI Usage](https://docs.brew.sh/Responsible-AI-Usage) for the principles behind them):
* You must disclose in the initial issue or pull request that you used AI/LLM and what tool/model/etc. you used.
* You must review all AI/LLM generated code, prose, etc. content before you ask anyone in Homebrew to review it for you.
* You must answer all maintainer questions and pull request review comments yourself, without using AI/LLM.
* You must attribute every commit to at least one human author or `Co-authored-by` co-author; attribution to AI/LLM is only allowed alongside them.
